pre_edit_verification.description: All eight current owned files matched admitted original hashes, all30 protected pins matched before source edits. Root entry board VALID1800 reused; no worker board commands. Admitted task/plan/baseline/admission and applicable instructions/source read.

baseline_case: Source-confirmed: dispatcher produces generic event/retry messages that index.ts acknowledges without consuming; all five tracking/event-webhook callers ignore destination failure. Existing fixtures assert these queue sends. No failed baseline runtime claimed.
implementation: EventDispatcher keeps parallel synchronous destination attempts, transforms and internal result array; validates the whole parsed destination array before assigning any member; removes generic queue writes/helpers entirely.

Shared dispatchForResponse permits original success shapes only after at least one destination and all HTTP acknowledgements. Public failures contain fixed error text and status/attempted/acknowledged only; unexpected rejected dispatch reports unconfirmed with null counts.

Both tracking routes and all three event webhooks consume shared results. Single tracking failures retain eventId/time. Batch failures preserve input order and continuation, distinguish all-unconfigured503 from mixed/unconfirmed502, and remove raw exception disclosure.

Exactly three new grouped receipt tests, affected existing consent/time/telemetry/service/native assertions updated, native wrapper unchanged. Existing source enrichment api/batch, occurrence times/IDs, prevalidation, authority, consent and refusal remain.

API Eventing contract describes acknowledgement semantics, safe receipt fields and status codes, no new generic queue/background retry, duplicate-risk and durable-recovery limitations; webhook row points to it.
